test_title: SSC CGL 2023 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On: 25 Jul 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: **Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank no. 3.**
solution: The correct answer is: **Derived** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • **Derived **means to obtain or receive something from a source or origin. (किसी स्रोत या मूल से कुछ प्राप्त करना) • The word fits the context of the sentence, as something is being obtained or received from a certain process. • **Example**: *The scientist derived a new formula from the raw materials.* Therefore, the correct answer is **option 3**. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** • **Extracted **means to remove or take out something, usually from a larger whole. (किसी चीज़ को हटाना या निकालना) • **Constructed **means to build or put together something. (किसी चीज़ का निर्माण या संयोजन करना) • **Build **means to construct or create something, usually with physical materials. (किसी चीज़ का निर्माण या निर्माण करना) 15e:T9cf, The correct answer is: **Substances**.
